patch.value: GH-1602: Windows extension-handler refusal has warning bytes before its JSON error envelope

Hosted Nightly Validation 40303228148 at 46fd91415c6e1009cff69f64c24fc17186a2af81 failed Windows Node 24 shard 3/4. The existing CLI integration control for a matched extension handler throwing reached expectJsonErrorEnvelope at cli.integration.spec.ts:5639, but JSON.parse of stderr began with warning:se and failed. The log does not expose enough of the prefix to identify its producer. Other results: 3086 passed, 19 skipped. This is a concrete transport framing failure signature, not evidence of a Sentry, settings or product cause. Source: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1602 and https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/actions/runs/40303228148. Preserve the completed recurrence meter and prior distinct platform failures.

Identify the exact warning producer through an isolated native control before selecting a fix; Machine-readable stderr remains one parseable JSON envelope while meaningful warnings remain represented and handler details remain intact; Preserve exit 1 and obtain a clean affected Windows regression cohort without erasing recurrence observations
Agents receive a parseable structured extension-handler failure on Windows without warning bytes preceding its JSON envelope.
